headline: Fragile semiconductor relief, not a confirmed bottom: green premarket snapshots confront damaged momentum and earnings-event risk.

Completed-bar momentum is damaged: 9/10 names have negative VEL5. SIMO alone remains positive, but its velocity is decelerating.
Premarket snapshots are broadly green after Monday declines. They are asynchronous, often zero-volume indications—not live quotes or verified executable liquidity.
Earnings sequence: AMD tonight, ARM and QCOM November 4, NET November 5. Today terminal-close bands do not include tonight’s AMD after-hours reaction.
Monthly conviction is much weaker than tactical bounce positioning: most notes are defensive or neutral after repeated direction misses. Wide range containment is not forecasting skill.
Customer financing and memory costs connect the group: priced debt is not settled cash or supplier orders, and component scarcity can hurt customer affordability.
NET defers AI Search billing to December 1; MU’s supplier financing and SIMO’s working-capital needs make cash conversion more important than adoption headlines.
